sentences.text:
Subhajyoti Dasgupta & Ors vs Unknown on 3 September, 2025
09 03.09.2025 Crr 3223 of 2025
Nb
 Ct. No.22
In the matter of:- Subhajyoti Dasgupta & Ors.
...petitioners Mr. Indranuj Dutta, Mr. Atanu Basu, Ms. Benazir Sk.
...for the petitioners.

This application is filed under Section 528 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 for
quashing of the impugned proceeding being Case No.AC-1893 of 2024 pending before the learned
Judicial Magistrate, 7th Court, Alipore, South 24 Parganas under Sections 498A and 34 of the
Indian Penal Code.
Learned counsel for the petitioners is present and submits that the petitioners are husband and in laws of opposite party no.2.

On her complaint made to the Commissioner of Police, Kolkata on 10th June, 2024, one FIR being Bansdroni PS Case No.510 of 20th June, 2022 under Section 498A and 34 was started against Subhajyoti Dasgupta, Kalpana Dasgupta, Sabyasachi Dasgupta, Rimi Dasgupta and it was entrusted to Tapan Majumder for the investigation.

entities.text: Bansdroni PS Case No.510 of 20th June, 2022
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: He further submits that on her complaint made to the Court of learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Alipore, a cognizance of the offences were taken by the Court on 21st June, 2024.
By the order dated 11th April, 2024, the case was fixed on 05th August, 2025, the date was fixed for the appearance and SR.
He prayed that two criminal proceedings against same persons initiated on the complaint of same petitioners for selfsame incident, is not maintainable and liable to quash.
Upon perusal of the record and having heard the learned counsel, I find that the application raises a disputed question of fact, which requires detailed consideration.
Accordingly, this application is admitted for hearing.

The petitioners are directed to serve a copy of this revisional application on opposite party no.1/State through the office of the learned Public Prosecutor and opposite party no.2/complainant, Susmita Dasgupta at her residential address through speed post with acknowledgement due and file an affidavit of service to that effect on the adjourned date.
List this matter for hearing on 10th September, 2025.

(Uday Kumar, J.)
